This portfolio collects a series of real projects I have developed at work, with a focus on financial data, treasury workflows, and analytics. The projects are designed to be reproducible and demonstrate my skills in data engineering, analysis, and visualization.

This portfolio is a work in progress, and I will continue to add new projects as they are completed. The projects are organized into sections based on their focus area, and each project includes a brief description and a link to the full report.

## Projects

### FX Prime Brokerage Collateral

This project demonstrates a workflow improvement approach for FX prime brokerage collateral management, based on a financial-services use case. The portfolio version uses synthetic data to reproduce the analytical workflow while preserving the structure of the underlying business problem.

The project involved:

\- Analyzing the existing collateral management process for FX prime brokerage.

\- Identifying inefficiencies and areas for improvement.

\- Implementing a new workflow that streamlined the process and reduced manual effort.

\- New Power BI dashboards for collateral reporting and monitoring.
